name: orchestrate
title_zh: 拆分大任务到多个工作会话，你点头才开工
tagline_zh: 跨仓库、多切片的大活，不用自己来回切上下文。它把任务拆给并行 worker，每个会话盯一块，你只负责点头和验收。
tagline_en: Big work spanning repos or slices? No more context-switching. It fans out to parallel workers, each owning a.
desc_en: Orchestrate a large task with worker sessions on Promptobus. Use when work splits across repositories or independent slices, and the user asks to spawn workers, run in parallel, or watch a worker. Start workers only after explicit approval. Not for a one-line edit, a read, or a question. Isolated review of one diff without workers is solo-review.
why_zh: 不是替你干，是替你分。每个 worker 独立会话、互不污染上下文。
why_en: It doesn't do the work—it divides it. Each worker gets an isolated session, no context bleed, and nothing starts until you.
limit_zh: 只认跨仓库或可独立切片的活；单行修改、只读、问答、单 diff 的孤立审查都不归它管。
limit_en: Only for cross-repo or independently sliceable work. Not for one-line edits, reads, Q&A, or solo diff review. Worker count capped by Promptobus.
title_en: Split big tasks across worker sessions, start only on your.
